dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Goal: meet p95 latency SLOs and keep unit cost 25-35% below hosted list pricing
Recommended baseline: 2 x 80GB GPU nodes (Redwood Dedicated pods) to cover sustained load (~15-20 qps effective with caching)
Burst capacity: autoscale to 5 nodes for daily digest windows (handles short 48 qps spikes with headroom)
Routing: keep a small hosted fallback pool for rare overflow and for lower-tier customers to save cost
KV cache configuration: enable cross-request prefix caching for reranking to reduce token spend by estimated 20%
Expected infra outcome: baseline throughput ~18 qps, burst headroom up to ~55 qps, p95 latency under 350ms on test workloads
